title: Weird experience I have when I’m ‘restless dreaming’, wondering if it’s just me.
content: This is so random but I want to know if I’m not alone in this. Every month or so I’ll have a night where I feel like I wake up every 10 minutes and I call it ‘restless dreaming’. It’s happened to me ever since I can remember (I’m 21 now) and I don’t know what triggers it. I believe it happens because I’ll tend to have an extremely short and totally abstract dream (I.e., I can’t explain it at all) that only goes for a specified time and once the dream ends, I’m forced awake and have to change my sleeping position (hence ‘restless’) - before I fall back asleep and the exact same process (and dream) repeat over and over. I feel like this repeats around 10-30 times and know it can go on for hours. It’s probably the most frustrating thing in my life, because I’m in this weird state of being half-awake/half-asleep and the dream kind of blurs reality while I’m in it. The next day is always terrible and I feel like I never slept at all. Not sure if this post will make sense to most, but I really want to know if anyone else goes through something similar.
